meta.title: Workspace Memory
meta.description: Curates earlier conversations in the same project and injects a handoff into a new conversation. The model is called only after you click Inject memory and confirm.

prepared: Curated. It will be injected with your first message.
privacy: The project summary will be sent to this model provider.
noSources: No earlier conversation with content in this project.
notBlank: This conversation already has a message.
subagent: Subagent conversations do not inject memory.
already: Memory has already been prepared for this conversation.
panelEmpty: Open a conversation in a project to view its memory.
panelDisabled: Memory is not configured for this project yet.
notesHint: Notes are inserted verbatim and never rewritten by the model.
resetConfirm: Delete the saved brief and cache for this project?
